about: What OCR services that bill by the call charge, kept by hand: known-models.json is regenerated from LiteLLM's list and holds models billed by the token. A price is in US dollars per 1,000 calls. Where a service lists another currency, the entry keeps the listed price, the rate used and the day it was read, so the next edit can redo the sum.

ocr.rate: 27,000 VND to the US dollar, the rate AI Hay's own prices use
ocr.source: AI Hay Platform dashboard, Billing, Pricing, as read for BeyondPilot BEY-102
